faqs.q: Sec. 50-4. - Depositing waste; damming or clogging ditches.
faqs.a:
It shall be unlawful for any person to deposit waste or debris of any kind or description
               or in any way dam, clog, or interfere with the water running in any canal or ditch
               or cause the same to overflow upon the streets, alleys, or public highways of the
               city.
(
Ord. No. 4875
, § 1, 8-19-2024)
